summary: Explained current Next.js SSG/ISR configuration for the user's crm-demo. Repo uses Next 16.3.6 App Router with cacheComponents not enabled, so static dynamic routes use generateStaticParams and ISR can use export const revalidate = N plus revalidatePath/revalidateTag. Also noted Pages Router equivalents getStaticProps/getStaticPaths and that Next 16 Cache Components changes the caching/revalidation model.
